_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of customer returns and associated inventory updates.

catalog_returns._description: Tracks customer returns data for catalog items, including details on dates, quantities, and reasons.

columns.name: cr_returned_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for returned dates in the catalog_returns table.

columns.name: cr_returned_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for returned times in catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items associated with catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_refunded_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers of customers who have had refunded returns.

columns.name: cr_refunded_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customer demographic records associated with refunded items.

columns.name: cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique demo-day identifiers for refunded catalog return transactions.

columns.name: cr_refunded_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique SK identifiers for refunded customer addresses.

columns.name: cr_returning_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers of customers who have previously made returns.

columns.name: cr_returning_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique customer demo keys associated with returned items.

columns.name: cr_returning_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for home demographics associated with catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_returning_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for returning addresses in the catalog_returns table.

columns.name: cr_call_center_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for call centers associated with catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_catalog_page_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential page identifiers for catalog return items.

columns.name: cr_ship_mode_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various shipping modes used in catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_warehouse_sk
columns.description: Stores the unique identifier for the warehouse associated with each catalog return.

columns.name: cr_reason_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various return reasons in the catalog_returns table.

columns.name: cr_order_number
columns.description: Stores unique order numbers for return transactions.

columns.name: cr_return_quantity
columns.description: Stores the quantity of returned items in catalog sales.

columns.name: cr_return_amount
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of items returned by customers.

columns.name: cr_return_tax
columns.description: Stores the tax amount for catalog return transactions.

columns.name: cr_return_amt_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores the total return amount including tax, in floating point format.

columns.name: cr_fee
columns.description: Stores monetary fees associated with catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_return_ship_cost
columns.description: Stores the cost of shipping returns for catalog items.

columns.name: cr_refunded_cash
columns.description: Stores refunded cash amounts (in dollars) for catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_reversed_charge
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of reversed charges for catalog returns.

columns.name: cr_store_credit
columns.description: Stores store credit amounts for individual return transactions.

columns.name: cr_net_loss
columns.description: Stores the net loss amount (in dollars) for each catalog return transaction.

store_returns._description: Tracks customer returns data for individual items at specific stores, including reasons, quantities, and associated costs.

columns.name: sr_returned_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for returned dates in store_returns.

columns.name: sr_return_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential store return time identifiers, incremented for each new return.

columns.name: sr_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items associated with store returns.

columns.name: sr_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customers associated with store returns.

columns.name: sr_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique store return demographic keys.

columns.name: sr_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for store return demo scenarios.

columns.name: sr_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for store return addresses.

columns.name: sr_store_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for stores associated with return transactions.

columns.name: sr_reason_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various return reasons in the store_returns table.

columns.name: sr_ticket_number
columns.description: Stores unique return ticket numbers for store transactions.

columns.name: sr_return_quantity
columns.description: Stores the quantity of returned items by each store.

columns.name: sr_return_amt
columns.description: Stores the monetary amount of returns made by customers at individual stores.

columns.name: sr_return_tax
columns.description: Stores the tax amount for individual store return transactions.

columns.name: sr_return_amt_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores the total return amount (including tax) for each store transaction.

columns.name: sr_fee
columns.description: Stores store-specific return fees, as indicated by sample values.

columns.name: sr_return_ship_cost
columns.description: Stores the shipping cost for store returns.

columns.name: sr_refunded_cash
columns.description: Stores the refunded cash amounts for individual store return transactions.

columns.name: sr_reversed_charge
columns.description: Stores the total amount (in dollars) of reversed charges for store returns.

columns.name: sr_store_credit
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of store credits for individual return transactions.

columns.name: sr_net_loss
columns.description: Stores the total net loss amount for individual store return transactions.

web_returns._description: Tracks web-based return transactions, including details on returned items, customers, demographics, addresses, reasons, and associated costs.

columns.name: wr_returned_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys for return dates in web_returns table.

columns.name: wr_returned_time_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integers representing timestamps for returned items in web sales.

columns.name: wr_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for items associated with web returns.

columns.name: wr_refunded_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers of customers who have had refunded returns.

columns.name: wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customer demographics associated with refunded web returns.

columns.name: wr_refunded_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential demo-specific identifiers for refunded web returns.

columns.name: wr_refunded_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for refunded shipping addresses in web return transactions.

columns.name: wr_returning_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for returning customers in web return transactions.

columns.name: wr_returning_cdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customer demographics associated with web returns.

columns.name: wr_returning_hdemo_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for home demographics associated with web returns.

columns.name: wr_returning_addr_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for returning addresses in web_returns table.

columns.name: wr_web_page_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for web pages associated with return transactions.

columns.name: wr_reason_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for reasons behind customer returns in web_returns table.

columns.name: wr_order_number
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for orders associated with web returns.

columns.name: wr_return_quantity
columns.description: Stores the quantity of items returned by customers in web sales.

columns.name: wr_return_amt
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of items returned by customers in web sales.

columns.name: wr_return_tax
columns.description: Stores the tax amount for web return transactions.

columns.name: wr_return_amt_inc_tax
columns.description: Stores the total return amount including tax, in floating point format.

columns.name: wr_fee
columns.description: Stores fees associated with web returns.

columns.name: wr_return_ship_cost
columns.description: Stores float values representing costs for shipping web returns.

columns.name: wr_refunded_cash
columns.description: Stores the refunded cash amounts (in dollars) for web returns.

columns.name: wr_reversed_charge
columns.description: Stores the monetary value of reversed charges for web returns.

columns.name: wr_account_credit
columns.description: Stores account credit amounts for web returns transactions.

columns.name: wr_net_loss
columns.description: Stores total net loss (in dollars) for each web return transaction.
